text.body: vyālaśikṣā atha śikṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi vyālamaunimatānugām padasandhisamāyuktāṃ svarasandhiyutāṃ tathā 1 yā padasya ṣaḍāvṛttiḥ sā jaṭetyabhidhīyate kramoktapadajātaṃ yaduttaraṃ taddvirabhyaset 2 tataḥ pūrvaṃ dvirabhyasya dvitīye tatsamāpayet dvitīyamuttareṇaivamarddharcānte samāpayet 3 iti jaṭā tribhiḥ padaiḥ kramo yastu sakṛduktvāya maddhyamam antyameva dvirabhyasya maddhyamantu sakṛdvadet 4 tataḥ pūrvaṃ dvirabhyasya madhyamantu sakṛdvadet yathāvasānamardharcāṃ kramavadveṣṭanaṃ bhavet 5 iti trikramajaṭā jaṭāvadabhyasenmālāmādyupāntyapadaṃ smṛtam kramaścānukramaḥ proktaḥ pūrvaṃ vyālamaharṣiṇā 6 iti mālā kramamuktvā viparyasya punaśca kramamuttaram ekavāraṃ śikhetīsā jaṭe vāntaṃ samāpayet 7 iti śikhā jaṭāvadabhyasedrekhāmardharcātpūrvamuttaram yuktvā dvābhyāṃ jaṭaivontaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāAZlamaharṣiṇā 8 iti rekhā kramā dvitricaturthokto vargo vā ṛci vā kramāt evaṃ daṇḍaścocyate sā varddharcānte samāpayet 9 iti daṇḍaḥ kramamuktvā viparyasya punaśca kramamuttaram tadutkramya punaḥ brūyāt ṛcāntaṃ kramavadrathaḥ 10 iti rathaḥ jaṭottaraṃ dvirabhyasya caikaikaṃ madhyamādikam sandhivatkramavacceti ghana ityucyate budhaiḥ 11 iti ghanaḥ śikhevānukramanteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ kramamabhyaset jaṭe vāntaṃ veṣṭanīyyaṃ vyālena ghana ucyate 12 iti pāṭhāntaram iti vyālaśikṣā samāptā
